macros.name: belowfootnoteskip
macros.doc: The typesetting parameter specifies the amount of the space inserted below footnotes of single-column pre-environment stuff if it does not have bottom floats.

macros.name: definecolumnpreamble
macros.doc: The command is to define the column preamble pream for the column col , which is inserted at every column-switching to the column.

macros.name: definethecounter
macros.doc: The command defines \thectr being {rep} for the local use in the column col .

macros.name: ensurevspace
macros.doc: The command tells the first synchronizing column-switching command (i.e., \switchcolumn[col ]*) or environment (i.e., column*, etc.) following this command that the page must be broken before synchronization unless the synchronization point has the space of len or more below it in the page.

macros.name: flushpage
macros.doc: The command flushes pages up to the top page in which the leading column resides.

macros.name: fncounteradjustment
macros.doc: The command \fncounteradjustment is to let \end{paracol} adjust the value of the counter based on its value at \begin{paracol} and the number of footnote commands in the environment.

macros.name: footnote*
macros.doc: The command is similar to its non-starred counterpart but the explicit numbering with the optional argument is done in self-relative or base-displacement style.

macros.name: footnotetext*

macros.name: globalcounter
macros.doc: The command \globalcounter{ctr } declares that the counter ctr is global to all columns, while \globalcounter* does so for all counters.
